about: P66 T1: one sentence per current genre for e2e/play-perf.spec.ts @measure (PERF_GAMES_FILE). The perf report records the genre the server actually published. tap = the clock waits for the first tap into the scene (TAP_TO_START in ArcadePlay.tsx), so the probe taps the canvas centre once after start.
